instructions: Prepare the smoky almond crumble: preheat the oven to 300°F and line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.

Place the almonds on 1 prepared baking sheet. In a small bowl, whisk together the smoked paprika, onion powder, salt, olive oil, maple syrup, coconut aminos, and liquid smoke (if using). Pour the mixture over the almonds and toss thoroughly to coat.
Spread the coated almonds in a single layer and bake for 12-15 minutes, until deep golden brown, stirring after 5-7 minutes. Let cool completely, then roughly chop.
Raise the oven temperature to 400°F. Place the frozen Brussels sprouts on the second prepared baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven and drizzle with the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Return to the oven and roast for an additional 15 minutes. Serve warm, topped with the smoky almond crumble.

title: Maple Balsamic Brussels Sprouts with Smoky Almond Bits
